shortDescription: UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Main Examination 2026 for 1,308 posts under Advt. No. 18-Exam/2026. Apply online from 14 September to 05 October 2026.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the notification for the Veterinary Pharmacist Main Examination 2026 under Advt. No. 18-Exam/2026 for 1,308 posts. Candidates who have the required UPSSSC PET 2025 score card and meet the eligibility conditions can apply online.

UPSSSC Veterinary Pharmacist Main Examination 2026

Post: Veterinary Pharmacist
Total Posts: 1,308
Advertisement: 18-Exam/2026

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 14/09/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 05/10/2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 05/10/2026
  • Form Correction Last Date: 12/10/2026
  • Main Examination Date: As per Schedule
  • Exam City: Before Exam
  • Admit Card: Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS: Rs. 25/-
  • SC / ST: Rs. 25/-
  • PH (Divyang): Rs. 25/-

Pay the examination fee through UPI, debit card, credit card or net banking.

Vacancy Details

  • Veterinary Pharmacist: 1,308 posts
  • UR: 576
  • EWS: 130
  • OBC: 359
  • SC: 237
  • ST: 06

Eligibility

  • UPSSSC PET 2025 score card
  • 10+2 Intermediate with Biology or equivalent qualification
  • 2 or 3 month Diploma in Veterinary Pharmacy
  • Knowledge of Hindi in Devanagari script

Read the complete notification for exact eligibility, syllabus, selection procedure, pay scale and other instructions before applying.
